summary: Consolidate select-editor into one file with URL floor validation, chip remove buttons, chip-scoped undo/redo, opt-in creation, empty state, and option limit

entries.summary: Merge `tag.tsx` into `select-editor.tsx`, validate stored chip URLs with `linkUrlValidation`, add non-blurring chip remove buttons, enable chip-scoped undo/redo while preserving prior history across controlled echoes and refusals, keep the caret after middle-inserted chips, default `creatable` to `false` with an empty state, and cap rendered menu options with `limit` (default `100`).
migrationNotes: Import TagPlugin and TagElement from @/components/editor/select-editor instead of @/components/editor/tag.
Pass creatable if the field should allow creating new labels from typed search.
Apps persisting v54 envelopes with TagPlugin see a schema fingerprint change from linkUrlValidation; bump the app schema version or strip invalid tag urls before reloading persisted v54 envelopes.

entries.summary: Wrap the demo in a `<form>` with submit validation feedback, pass `creatable`, and label the read-only toggle button.
